name: WELLCHIP
recent: Well Chip 于2026年11月完成1股配5股的可放弃供股，发行1.2亿新股，认购率达123.33%，新股于11月17日上市。同期董事及大股东出现权益变动，包括CEO Ng Hooi Lang在10月减持部分凭单。最新季度（2026年9月30日止）净利同比下滑18%，但9个月累计净利仍同比增长15.1%。
notable: 完成可放弃供股，发行1.2亿新股，认购率123.33%，超额认购23.33%。
供股新股于2026年11月17日在大马交易所主板上市交易。
董事及大股东于11月17日申报权益变动，涉及供股认购。
risks: 供股发行1.2亿新股，占扩大后股本约16.7%，可能摊薄每股盈利。
CEO Ng Hooi Lang于10月20日至23日期间多次减持凭单。
最新季度净利同比下滑18%，主要因利润率收窄及成本上升。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收7161.3万令吉，环比下降5.8%，同比增长8.7%；净利2393万令吉，环比下降14.2%，同比增长17.9%；净利率33.4%，低于上季度的36.7%。

recent_en: Well Chip completed a renounceable rights issue of 1-for-5 in November 2026, issuing 120 million new shares with a subscription rate of 123.33%, and the new shares were listed on 17 November. Meanwhile, there were changes in directors' and substantial shareholders' interests, including CEO Ng Hooi Lang disposing of some rights in October. The latest quarter (ended 30 September 2026) saw net profit fall 18% year-on-year, though 9-month cumulative net profit still grew 15.1% year-on-year.
notable_en: Completed renounceable rights issue, issuing 120 million new shares with a subscription rate of 123.33%, an over-subscription of 23.33%.
Rights shares were listed and quoted on the Main Market of Bursa Securities on 17 November 2026.
Directors and substantial shareholders reported changes in interests on 17 November, related to rights subscriptions.
risks_en: The rights issue of 120 million new shares represents about 16.7% of the enlarged share capital, potentially diluting earnings per share.
CEO Ng Hooi Lang disposed of rights multiple times between 20 and 23 October.
Latest quarter net profit fell 18% year-on-year, mainly due to narrower margins and higher costs.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM71.613 million, down 5.8% QoQ but up 8.7% YoY; net profit was RM23.93 million, down 14.2% QoQ but up 17.9% YoY; net margin was 33.4%, lower than 36.7% in the previous quarter.
